نتوافر (form VI)
# نَتَوَافَرُ (natawāfaru) /na.ta.waː.fa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
# نَتَوَافَرَ (natawāfara) /na.ta.waː.fa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
# نَتَوَافَرْ (natawāfar) /na.ta.waː.far/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَوَافَرَ (tawāfara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
